design_authority: docs/us_short_system_design.md §5.1a (SEC 增发/转售 hard veto = 近期+已激活+重大; 挂着的 shelf/陈旧/小额不当硬否决) / §3.1 (provenance) / §3.3 (关键 unknown 不当 clean) / §3.5 (PIT: 观测/来源不得晚于决策 as_of)
authorization_note: OFFLINE contract SHAPE only. Live SEC fetch + runner wiring stay gated under SR-PROVIDER-001. Reachability of the SEC submissions form-type + filing-date channel was proven 2026-07-01 (docs/us_short_cut5_pass2_feasibility_probe_summary_20260701.json: SEC submissions 3/3 reachable, form families + filingDate/acceptanceDateTime available). This binding freezes the shape a producer must honor; it selects no provider and authorizes no fetch/DataHub/production/ship-gate.
foreign_and_reit_note: Families cover DOMESTIC registrations (S-1 IPO / S-11 REIT / S-3 + S-3ASR shelf) AND FOREIGN-issuer analogs (F-1 / F-3 / F-3ASR) — NYSE/NASDAQ-listed ADRs file the F-* series for offerings with identical dilution mechanics, so a domestic-only family set would miss a real ADR dilution. 424B prospectus supplements (takedowns) are domicile-agnostic and cover both. exact_or_amend matches 'FORM' and 'FORM/A...' but not longer forms (S-1 != S-11, S-3 != S-30/S-3ASR listed separately).
recency_window_basis: calendar days before as_of. §5.1a '近期' recency prior — a REVIEWED calibration prior, NOT validated alpha; it does not imply a ship-gate. Change = reviewed schema + binding version bump (never a silent drift).

status_derivation.active: a RECENT takedown (424B*) offering filing exists (an actual prospectus supplement / ATM sale — the shelf is being used)
status_derivation.registered_shelf: only a recent registration (S-1 / S-3 / S-3ASR) exists with NO recent takedown (挂着的 shelf ≠ 马上增发)

materiality_policy: materiality (offering SIZE / dollar amount) is UNAVAILABLE from the submissions form-type list; it needs 424B document-text parsing (gated, a later slice). It is emitted as null. Downstream hard_veto maps recent + active + materiality=null to strong_downgrade (没数据≠安全), NOT a hard veto (materiality not confirmed material).
excluded_forms_note: S-8 (employee benefit-plan shares — routine comp, not a §5.1a dilution veto) and 25-NSE (delisting notice — owned by the status source, not the offering audit) are deliberately NOT offering-dilution vetoes and contribute no active_offering signal here.

emission_fitness.note: only a full-coverage clean-parse ticker emits an offering audit signal; partial / missing / failed / degraded -> excluded (conservative — the offline slice has no data-quality downgrade channel to the gate, so it fails closed rather than assert offering status on incomplete data).

date_format: as_of / filing_date / source_as_of = YYYY-MM-DD (SEC-native, ASCII, real-calendar); observed_at + acceptance_datetime = tz-aware RFC3339 date-time (instant)
pit_rule: observed_at is an INSTANT STRICTLY before the 09:30 ET decision open on as_of (half-open window [prior_close, decision_open), matching resolve_canonical_asof); chronology observed_at ET-date <= source_as_of <= as_of; per filing acceptance_datetime (the EDGAR public instant) <= observed_at — a filing made public AFTER the observation (or at/after the decision open) is look-ahead and EXCLUDED, never contributing recency/status; filing_date <= observed ET-date.

duplicate_policy.note: a SEC accession is a globally-unique per-filing identity; a repeated/blank/whitespace accession within a ticker fails closed (never silently deduped or double-counted into recency/status).

checked_empty_note: a full-coverage clean-parse ticker with NO in-window offering filing emits a CHECKED coverage record (disposition audited_no_active_offering) retaining its provenance — a safety-audit 'looked, found no active offering', DISTINCT from a ticker never queried (§3.3, must not collapse audited-clean to unknown).
